tests.name: qt_keywords_unflatten
tests.intent: Verify that json unflattening compiles and executes successfully when Qt keyword macros such as slots, signals, emit, foreach, and forever are defined.

tests.name: json_pointer_growth_and_lookup
tests.intent: Verify prefix tree growth and collision handling during deep nested JSON pointer construction and lookups.

tests.name: json_pointer_operators
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer concatenation via operator/ with strings and indices under Qt macro definitions.

tests.name: qt_keywords_patch
tests.intent: Verify JSON patch application using paths that trigger prefix tree creation when Qt macros are defined.

tests.name: gen_05
tests.intent: Trigger prefix_tree::grow by inserting many unique children into an unflatten structure, exercising table vector allocation and rehashing.

tests.name: gen_06
tests.intent: Exercise prefix_tree table lookups and matching existing child nodes with identical hashes or collisions during unflatten operations.

tests.name: gen_07
tests.intent: Explicitly instantiate and utilize json_pointer prefix tree construction via deeply nested unflatten paths requiring initial table capacity and load factor checks.

tests.name: gen_08
tests.intent: Test prefix tree rehashing and slot indexing mask calculations by executing unflatten on a json patch containing multiple colliding hash keys.

tests.name: gen_09
tests.intent: Trigger table size expansion (grow) path during unflattening by supplying a large number of distinct deeply-nested keys under Qt keyword macro definitions.
